shots.beat: The ancient settlement at golden hour: a valley built around a ring of stone.

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game; g.player.place(1.35,0,38.0,Math.PI); TR.place('tala',-0.6,0,33.2,Math.PI); TR.walk('tala',[[-0.7,12],[-0.6,-2]],1.3); g.input.setStick(0,0.36,0.36); return 'kai and tala walking to the ring'})()

shots.characters: Kai walking away from the lens toward the Old Ring (a calm 1.5 m/s walk, analog stick), Tala walking beside him on the left, villagers on the plaza around the Ring
shots.lighting: The mission's golden-hour sun low behind the Ring (frame left), warm valley haze; no rig light, Kai's back stays in the house shadow.
shots.sound: Wind and water bed; the switch transition lands on the cut.
shots.notes: Telephoto (24 to 23 deg) walk-away between two houses that frame the Ring: the camera cranes up 0.65 m and creeps in while Kai walks away from it, so he shrinks into the valley and the Ring rises clear above him. Focus holds on Kai, then racks to the Ring at 2.1 s. The tree on the lens line (-0.5, 30.1) is hidden for the whole shot.

preview.note: Golden hour, villagers, the stone ring; faceted low-poly trees (known mission 4 item).

shots.beat: Niko, keeper of the Telling, reads the ring on Kai's wrist: "You came before the first fire."

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game,k=g.player.char,n=g.actors.niko; n.root.position.set(2.5,0.6,-6.2); n.root.rotation.y=0.477; g.player.place(3.37,0.3,-4.51,-2.664); g.input.setStick(0,0,0); n.lookTarget=k.head; k.lookTarget=n.head; TR.clip('kai','talk',0.3,0.7); return 'niko faces kai in front of the Ring'})()

shots.characters: Niko (medium close-up, talking to Kai: the VO line), Kai (soft foreground head and shoulder, frame left; his steady 'talk' clip at 0.7x so his head does not wander like the idle does)
shots.lighting: Niko stands between the lens and the Old Ring: the low sun behind the Ring rims him, the dialogue rig keys his face, and the Ring's glowing inner rim makes a halo around him; the halo fragments sweep behind.
shots.notes: Long-lens over-the-shoulder (19.5 to 18.5 deg) with a slow 0.4 m push. Niko on the platform at (2.5, 0.6, -6.2) faces Kai (3.37, 0.3, -4.51); the camera sits on the far side of the Niko-Ring line so the Ring frames him. Niko talks from 0.92 s (the VO 'The ring on your wrist is the Ring in our valley...'), Kai answers from 2.62 s ('I've never been here.').

preview.note: Niko medium close-up framed by the village Ring.

shots.beat: One valley, two ages: the thriving village switches to Helix's drowned Reservoir 7.
shots.characters: Villagers in the lanes (thriving); dead trees standing in the water (flooded)
shots.lighting: Golden hour to overcast 2049 daylight; water level rises over the same houses.
shots.sound: Switch stinger, then the causal-consequence resonance under the dam hum.

preview.note: Thriving village switches to the flooded reservoir with dead trees.

shots.beat: The Sky House: the observatory at dawn c. 1000 BCE switches to Helix's floodlit 2049 night.
shots.characters: Keepers and acolytes on the court (too small to read)
shots.lighting: Over the drum toward the sunrise, then the same view at night: a starfield over Helix floodlights and scaffolds.
shots.sound: Night: glass tones under Mira's recorded voice.

preview.note: The dawn sky renders flat grey from this angle; the night half reads (stars, floodlights). Try a lower angle on the Sun Gate.

shots.beat: Montage: dusk on the ruined summit, 2196; the scavenger chief Dace on the pillar, gauntlet glowing.
shots.lighting: Sunset behind the broken rim, Venus low in the west, green gauntlet glow.

preview.note: Armillary, scavengers and their gauntlet glow against the dusk.

shots.beat: Montage: Reservoir 7, dead trees standing in the water over a village that never existed.
shots.lighting: Flat overcast light on the water, the dam across the valley.

preview.note: Dead trees in the reservoir, overcast.
